sloka: ततस्तृप्त इति ज्ञात्वा समुत्पेतुर्निशाचराः ।शिरोभिश्च प्रणम्यैनं सर्वतः पर्यवारयन् ।। ६.६०.६५ ।।।।
transliteration: tatastṛpta iti jñātvā samutpeturniśācarāḥ ।śirobhiśca praṇamyainaṁ sarvataḥ paryavārayan ।। 6.60.65 ।।।।

translations.english: He, the bull among the south west region, astonished at his awakening, soothed, and spoke to all the Rakshasas in this way.
